Updated the existing Treasury Bulletin currency/CPI skill and memory.

Generalizable lesson saved:
For prompts saying “official BLS CPI-U year-over-year inflation rate” or “12-month percent change,” use the BLS-published rounded YoY percentage rate, typically one decimal percent, rather than recomputing an unrounded CPI index ratio. For November 1969 this means using 6.0%, which explains the gold answer difference.
